name: tp8_row_major_memory_balance_v1
controls: Same complete eight-head TP8 block, row-major endpoint selection and assignment, direct-root rank-order SUM, rank-local output publication, fixed compute services, capacity, author network and seed. Change only common read/write memory-port bandwidth in both placements.
